Order 
This application under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. has been filed against the order dated 30.11.2023 passed by 11th ASJ Bhopal in Criminal Revision No. 396/2023 arising out of order dated 19.05.2023 passed by JMFC, Bhopal in Complaint Case No. 893/2022, by which the complaint filed by applicant has been dismissed on the ground of delay.

2. Challenging the orders passed by Courts below, it is submitted by counsel for applicant that applicant had filed a complaint that in the year, 2015, respondents have published a book in the name of Sen- Sandesh by misusing his name and, therefore, the act of respondents is punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468/34 of IPC.
The complaint was filed on 09.03.2022.
It is submitted that although the Magistrate has dismissed the complaint as barred by time but he should not have considered the merits.
3. Considered the submissions made by counsel for applicant.
4. Applicant has filed the complaint for offences under Sections 420, 467, 468/34 of IPC.
No limitation is provided for offence under Sections 467 and 468 of IPC because the maximum sentence is more than 3 years.
Therefore, unless and until the Magistrate comes to a conclusion that no offence under Sections 467 and 468 of IPC is made out, then he could not have dismissed the complaint on the ground of delay.

5. The Magistrate has come to a conclusion that at the most, it can be said that the allegations prima facie makes out an offence under Section 481 of IPC but since the maximum sentence is one year and the complaint was filed after seven years of commission of offence, therefore, the complaint was barred by time.
6.
Thus, the contention of applicant that the Magistrate should not have considered the merits of the case is misconceived.
Even otherwise, the counsel for applicant did not argue that the allegations made in the complaint would make out an offence under Sections 467 and 468 of IPC.

7. Since, no other arguments is advanced by counsel for applicant, therefore, this Court is of considered opinion that no jurisdictional error was committed by the Courts below by dismissing the complaint as barred by time.
